title: IMUDINO: Self-distilled Foundation Model for Inertial Sensing
abstract: arXiv:2611.07437v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We present IMUDINO, the first foundation model (FM) for inertial sensing to achieve competitive performance across diverse sensing tasks including human activity recognition (HAR), health, motion capture, and odometry. Prior inertial FMs often focus on one subfield of inertial sensing and sometimes underperform state-of-the-art supervised methods (e.g., in HAR), making their scope considerably narrower than FMs for vision and natural language. Moreover, they often require fixed input length and sampling rate, and generalize poorly to unseen sensor locations. To build a general-purpose foundation model for inertial sensing, we adapt the DINO self-supervised learning (SSL) paradigm to inertial data through a set of semantics-preserving motion transformations that simulate variations in motion pattern and sensor setup. translated_title: IMUDINO：面向惯性传感的自蒸馏基础模型
translated_abstract: 我们提出了IMUDINO，这是第一个在多种传感任务上均能取得具有竞争力性能的惯性传感基础模型（FM），涵盖人体活动识别（HAR）、健康监测、动作捕捉和里程计测量等任务。以往的惯性基础模型通常只关注惯性传感的某一个子领域，有时甚至表现不如最先进的监督学习方法（例如在人体活动识别任务中），这使其适用范围远窄于视觉和自然语言领域的基础模型。此外，这些模型往往要求固定的输入长度和采样率，并且对未见过的传感器佩戴位置泛化能力较差。为了构建一个通用的惯性传感基础模型，我们将DINO自监督学习（SSL）范式适配到惯性数据上，通过一组语义保持的运动变换来模拟运动模式和传感器设置的变化。在模型架构方面，我们使用带有频率感知位置编码的普通transformer编码器，原生支持（原文在此处被截断）
tldr: IMUDINO是首个在人体活动识别、健康监测、动作捕捉和里程计等多种惯性传感任务上均达到有竞争力性能的通用基础模型，其核心创新在于通过语义保持的运动变换将DINO自监督学习范式适配到惯性数据上。
en_tdlr: IMUDINO is the first general-purpose foundation model for inertial sensing that achieves competitive performance across diverse tasks including HAR, health, motion capture, and odometry, by adapting the DINO self-supervised learning paradigm to inertial data through semantics-preserving motion transformations.
